issues.title: Incorrect tauri version in metadata file
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file specifies tauri version as "2.8.2" but the actual tauri crate version is "2.8.3" as shown in crates/tauri/Cargo.toml. This version mismatch will cause the CLI to report incorrect version information to tools and scripts that depend on this metadata. The PR updated the tauri version to 2.8.3, but the metadata file was not updated accordingly, creating an inconsistency between the actual library version and the advertised version.

issues.title: Dependency version mismatch for tauri-bundler
issues.description: The tauri-cli Cargo.toml declares a dependency on tauri-bundler version "2.6.0", but the actual tauri-bundler crate version is "2.6.1" as specified in crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml. This creates a version constraint mismatch that could cause build failures or prevent the CLI from using the updated bundler with the bug fix for 32-bit Windows builds. The CHANGELOG indicates this version should have been updated to 2.6.1 to pick up the binary patching fix.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14070 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary:
This is the covector release PR. It uses up two change files and bumps `tauri` to 2.8.3, `tauri-bundler` to 2.6.1, `tauri-cli` to 2.8.1 and `@tauri-apps/cli` to 2.8.2. It also updates the changelogs, both config schema `$id`s and Cargo.lock. Most of it matches what covector normally produces.

Two of the side effects covector normally applies are missing, though. First, `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json` still says `"tauri": "2.8.2"`. The `postversion` hook for `tauri` should have bumped it, as every earlier release did. Second, `tauri-cli`'s Cargo.toml still requires `tauri-bundler = "2.6.0"`, even though the new changelog entry says "Upgraded to `tauri-bundler@2.6.1`". The previous release (#13887) bumped this requirement. The PR also carries two edits a version bump wouldn't normally make: a new `homepage` field in tauri-bundler's Cargo.toml, and three `windows-sys`/`windows-targets` changes in Cargo.lock.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The release metadata disagrees with itself. `metadata-v2.json` lags the `tauri` crate version, which is baked into the CLI binary through `include_str!` and used by `tauri init` and `tauri plugin init`. And the CLI's bundler requirement contradicts its own changelog. Both should be fixed before tagging.

architecture.overview:
Tauri releases are driven by covector. Each `.changes/*.md` file names a package and a bump type. `covector version` reads `.changes/config.json`, bumps each package's manifest, follows the `dependencies` graph to bump dependents (for example `tauri-bundler` → `tauri-cli` → `@tauri-apps/cli`), writes CHANGELOG entries, and runs `postversion` hooks. For `tauri`, `tauri-build`, `tauri-plugin` and `@tauri-apps/cli`, the hook runs `.scripts/ci/sync-cli-metadata.js`, which rewrites `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`. For `tauri`, it also regenerates the JSON schema.

This PR is the output of that pipeline for two patch changes: one bundler fix and one tauri runtime fix. The manifest, changelog and schema `$id` updates are all there. The `tauri` metadata sync and the dependency requirement rewrite in `tauri-cli`'s Cargo.toml are not, even though the dependent bump itself (tauri-cli 2.8.1) went through.
steps: Start with the removed change files, `binary-patching-32-bit.md` (tauri-bundler patch) and `fix-webview2-path-timing.md` (tauri patch). They are the inputs to this release.
`.changes/config.json` defines the graph: `tauri-cli` depends on `tauri-bundler`, and `@tauri-apps/cli` depends on `tauri-cli`. So one bundler patch cascades into patch bumps for both CLIs.

Each package's Cargo.toml/package.json version and CHANGELOG.md is bumped. For a dependent, covector should also rewrite the dependency requirement, such as `tauri-bundler = { version = ... }` in `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml`.

The `postversion` hooks run `sync-cli-metadata.js` for `tauri` and `@tauri-apps/cli`, which updates `metadata-v2.json`. The `tauri` hook also rebuilds `tauri-schema-generator`, producing the new schema `$id`.
`metadata-v2.json` is compiled into the CLI with `include_str!`. `init.rs` and `plugin/init.rs` use its `tauri` field when scaffolding projects, and `info` uses its `cli.js` field.

findings.title: metadata-v2.json still pins `tauri` at 2.8.2 after bumping the crate to 2.8.3
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, the `tauri` field (line 6) is still "2.8.2", but this release bumps `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` to 2.8.3. The `postversion` hook for `tauri` in `.changes/config.json` (which runs `.scripts/ci/sync-cli-metadata.js`) should have updated it, and previous release commits such as #14041 always bumped it together with the crate. Change the value to "2.8.3" and leave the other fields alone. This file is embedded through `include_str!` in `crates/tauri-cli/src/init.rs` and `src/plugin/init.rs`, so it has to match the released tauri version.

findings.title: tauri-cli still requires tauri-bundler 2.6.0, despite its changelog saying "Upgraded to 2.6.1"
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` line 50, the `tauri-bundler` dependency still requires version "2.6.0". This release bumps tauri-bundler to 2.6.1, and the new tauri-cli 2.8.1 CHANGELOG entry says "Upgraded to `tauri-bundler@2.6.1`". Change the requirement to "2.6.1" and keep `default-features = false` and `path = "../tauri-bundler"`. This matches how the previous release (#13887) bumped it from 2.5.2 to 2.6.0. Then run `cargo metadata` or `cargo check -p tauri-cli` to confirm Cargo.lock doesn't change.

findings.title: Unrelated manifest and lockfile edits mixed into an automated version-bump PR
findings.body:
Two parts of this diff can't come from `covector version`.

First, a new `homepage` field in tauri-bundler's manifest:

::diff{file="crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml" lines="9-15"}

The value matches the workspace's `homepage = "https://tauri.app/"`, so this is harmless. Sibling crates use `homepage.workspace = true`, though. If this metadata change is wanted, inherit the workspace value and do it in a separate PR.

Second, Cargo.lock re-resolves `colored`, `libloading` and `winapi-util` from `windows-sys 0.48` / `windows-targets 0.48` to `0.59` / `0.52`. Their range requirements (for example `>=0.48, <=0.59`) allow this, so it isn't a bug. But it changes what Windows builds compile against, and it isn't mentioned in any changelog. In a release PR, unexplained dependency churn makes the release harder to audit and bisect.
findings.fixPrompt: This PR is supposed to contain only covector version-bump output, but it adds `homepage = "https://tauri.app/"` to `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml` (line 12) and re-resolves `windows-sys`/`windows-targets` for `colored`, `libloading` and `winapi-util` in `Cargo.lock`. Either revert both so the release diff only contains version bumps, or, if they're intentional, switch the bundler field to `homepage.workspace = true` to match the other crates and mention the change in the PR description.

findings.title: Changelogs, schema IDs and dependent bumps line up correctly
findings.body: Both change files are consumed, and each produces a correctly categorized CHANGELOG entry with its commit and PR links. The bundler patch correctly cascades to patch bumps for `tauri-cli` (2.8.1) and `@tauri-apps/cli` (2.8.2), following the `dependencies` graph in `.changes/config.json`. Both copies of `config.schema.json`, in `tauri-cli` and `tauri-schema-generator`, have their `$id` updated to `2.8.3`. The Cargo.lock version entries for the three Rust crates match their manifests.
